gloss: to be brought forward; to quicken; to be hasty

definitions.gloss: to be brought forward; to happen earlier
definitions.explanation: When a scheduled event or time occurs earlier than originally planned.
When a pace, heartbeat, or process speeds up.

definitions.gloss: to be hasty; to act rashly
definitions.explanation: To make a premature or impulsive decision.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{開始|かいし}{時間|じかん}が{早|はや}まった。
examples.english: The meeting start time was moved earlier.

examples.japanese: {緊張|きんちょう}で{脈|みゃく}が{早|はや}まった。
{早|はや}まったことをするな。

notes:
{早|はや}まる is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}). The transitive pair is {早|はや}める (to hasten, to bring forward).

ASPECT ({ている}):
{早|はや}まっている can indicate an ongoing quickened state or a resulting change in timing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {予定|よてい}が{早|はや}まる - schedule is moved earlier
- {脈|みゃく}/{心拍|しんぱく}が{早|はや}まる - pulse/heartbeat quickens
- {早|はや}まった{行動|こうどう} - hasty action
- {早|はや}まるな - don't be hasty/rash

USAGE NOTE:
In the sense of "being hasty," {早|はや}まる often carries a negative nuance, implying an impulsive or regrettable action.
